name: 성씨별 인구 (Statistics Korea, Population and Housing Census)
note: Korean surnames, from the census. A closed set: about 250 names, of which the top ten
are held by roughly two thirds of the country.
No artifacts, for the same reason `ssb-fornavn` and `surs-imena` have none. KOSIS
answers only to a registered API key, so there is no URL a build machine can fetch and
nothing to hash. The query is run by hand with `decoy-fetch korean-surnames`, its
result reviewed, and the snapshot committed — re-runnable and diffable instead of
Wikidata was tried first and has no Korean surnames tagged with P407. Relaxing that to
a script filter was tried second and is a trap: Hangul transliterates every foreign
name, so the query returns 애덤스 and 네타냐후 alongside 김. Onomaverse has six Korean
surnames and they are romanised. This is the only source that is both Korean and
KOGL Type 1 is Korea's open government licence: attribution required, commercial use
